text:
Aisha Patel: Noticing a spike in GPU eviction churn in ap-southeast2 starting ~09:22 UTC. Evictions correlate with a flurry of node-level NIC resets and kubelet marking GPUs NotReady. Small inference pods are piling up pending.

Ravi Narayan: Yep — preemption_count and bind_timeout both trending up. Scheduler logs show frequent 'binding failed: node tainted gpu:offline' entries.

Juniper Li: Local node logs from two affected hosts:
```
May 12 09:21:43 kernel: mlx5 0000:af:00.1: PCIe link down
May 12 09:21:44 dockerd: warning: network nat conntrack table full
May 12 09:21:45 kubelet: Pod eviction due to resource unhealthy: gpu
```
Pattern: net subsystem complaining, then GPU detach.

deploy-bot: ClusterEvent ap-southeast2: gpu_evictions > threshold. Ops incident created: INC-APSE2-92.

Opsana: Short-term playbook options: 1) scale warm pool +4 to soak pending pods; 2) cordon the repeatedly-flapping hosts so they don't hurt binpacking; 3) apply a soft `gpu-net-flaky=true:PreferNoSchedule` to bad racks. All buy time for firmware/conntrack fixes.

Aisha Patel: I've cordoned node ap2-node-77 and ap2-node-82 and started a drain. Also triggered a firmware restart on ap2-node-82 NIC (oncall approval).

Ravi Narayan: Command snippets for triage if others pick up:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
ssh ops@ap2-node-82 sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200
ssh ops@ap2-node-82 sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep -i error
```
Recommend increasing netfilter conntrack max to 524288 on hosts as emergency if counters near 90%.

Juniper Li: Long term: scheduler should be taught to prefer `net-stable=true` nodes when placing GPU-bound, latency-sensitive pods. Also evaluate bumping our node-level conntrack defaults and add NAT session metrics per-pod to detect noisy workloads.

Opsana: Rolled up a temporary ASG scale of +4 warm gpu instances for ap-southeast2 (started at 09:28 UTC). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/ap-southeast2/gpu-ops?orgId=1. Cost impact: estimated +$1.2k/day if sustained.

Aisha Patel: After cordons + warm pool the eviction rate dipped ~35% in first 10m. Still seeing isolated flaps on rack-3. Opening a maintenance ticket to replace NICs on 3 hosts.

Ravi Narayan: If we keep seeing alternating cordon/un-cordon churn we should disable immediate preemption in this region (increase preemption backoff) to avoid oscillatory packing. Small change: reduce preemption aggressiveness via scheduler-config ramp for ap-southeast2 only.

Juniper Li: Adding follow-up action items to INC-APSE2-92: 1) run conntrack audit across region; 2) schedule NIC firmware roll for rack-3; 3) implement scheduler canary that weights net-stable label; 4) finance: temporary spend delta note.

Aisha Patel: I'll post postmortem template and timeline once we stabilize. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
